text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe mentioned that she has “a 
weak constitution.” True to her words, a 
multitude of ailments began to surface.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rapid weight fluctuations occurring over 
short periods— and cracked hooves making 
it hard to even run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Faced with one physical irregularity after 
another, patience was the only way 
forward. The Trainer mobilized all their 
knowledge to handle the situation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, these numerous anomalies could 
not be dismissed as mere physical 
frailty... It was almost like a paranormal 
occurrence.
